description: NaCaGaSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.49 Å. Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.73 Å. Ga is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.95 Å) and one longer (2.35 Å) Ga-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ca and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.49 Å. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Si, and one O atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom.
